$comment: Reviewed dependency policy, enforced by scripts/check-licenses.mjs (every lockfile, offline, in `npm test`) and scripts/audit-deps.mjs (npm audit, in CI). Every published @zoijs package has ZERO runtime dependencies (scripts/check-deps.mjs), so everything below is development tooling: test runners, jsdom, TypeScript, Playwright, and the private brand-asset scripts. Add to an allow list or an exception only with a reason; every exception must still match something, and every accepted vulnerability expires.

licenses.$allowedComment: Permissive (OSI-approved or public-domain dedications) — no copyleft or field-of-use terms. Python-2.0 is argparse's permissive license (via eslint).

exceptions.reason: Prebuilt libvips binaries that sharp loads dynamically. Only the private, never-published brand-asset scripts in assets/ use them, to rasterize the logo; nothing from them is shipped or linked into any package, and CI never installs assets/.
Same as @img/sharp-libvips-*: the Windows builds bundle libvips. Private tooling, never shipped.
Same as @img/sharp-libvips-*: the WebAssembly build bundles libvips. Private tooling, never shipped.
The Poppins font (SIL Open Font License) used to draw the logo. OFL permits embedding in artwork; the font file itself is never redistributed.

audit.$comment: npm advisories accepted for a limited time. Each entry: { lockfile, package, advisory (the GHSA URL from npm audit), reason, expires: YYYY-MM-DD }. An expired or unmatched entry fails the audit. Empty means nothing is accepted.
